facts.text: Sanctuary is a Paradise Valley resort set on 53 acres of desert on Camelback Mountain.
facts.excerpt: Nestled within the picturesque landscapes of Camelback Mountain, Sanctuary is a famed Paradise Valley luxury resort set upon 53 acres of lush desert

facts.text: The resort grounds include manicured grounds, gardens and pools.
facts.excerpt: set upon 53 acres of lush desert featuring manicured grounds, gardens, pools

facts.text: The Mountain Casitas are set against the backdrop of Paradise Valley, with contemporary architecture and views.
facts.excerpt: Spacious mountain casitas nestled into the striking backdrop of Paradise Valley. Casitas offer an array of luxurious amenities, contemporary architecture, and breathtaking views.

facts.text: The private villas are on the mountainside, each with spacious accommodations and personalized amenities, suited to watching sunrises and sunsets across Camelback Mountain.
facts.excerpt: Private mountainside villas, each offering spacious accommodations and personalized amenities, perfect for watching sunrises and sunsets across Camelback Mountain.

facts.text: One villa offers 270 degrees of views, two master bedrooms, a pool, an expansive patio with an infinity-edge hot tub and a separate guest house.
facts.excerpt: The crown jewel on Camelback, with 270 degrees of breathtaking views, two master bedrooms, pool, expansive patio with an infinity-edge hot tub and separate guest house.

facts.text: One villa is a private enclave with a spa treatment room, a movement studio, a lawn and a private pool with a wrap-around patio.
facts.excerpt: A private enclave offering four bedrooms, spa treatment room, movement studio, spacious lawn and private pool with wrap-around patio.

facts.text: The Sanctuary Spa Suites have a spacious layout and an outdoor soaking tub.
facts.excerpt: Surrender to ultimate relaxation in Sanctuary Spa Suites with a spacious layout and outdoor soaking tub.

facts.text: The multi-level Spa Patio Casitas have an outdoor patio with landscape views.
facts.excerpt: Our chic, multi-level Spa Patio Casitas features an outdoor patio offering stunning landscape views.

facts.text: Casitas in the Villa del Sol enclave each have a king bedroom and a full bathroom with an indoor soaking tub and a private outdoor shower.
facts.excerpt: Located in Sanctuary’s Villa del Sol enclave, each of the four casitas, offers a king bedroom, table and chairs, large HD Smart TV, and a full bathroom with indoor soaking tub and private outdoor shower.

facts.text: Villa Norte has a spacious adobe-style design and southwestern decor.
facts.excerpt: Spacious adobe-style design and unique southwestern décor make Villa Norte

facts.text: Suites come in one- and two-bedroom options.
facts.excerpt: One and two bedroom suite options with even more room to relax.

facts.text: Sanctuary Spa's menu ranges from age-defying facials to desert-inspired body treatments.
facts.excerpt: From age‑defying facials to desert‑inspired body treatments, the spa offers an expansive menu of wellness experiences

facts.text: There are casita and suite options for mobility-accessible guests.
facts.excerpt: Sanctuary Camelback Mountain offers four magnificent casita and suite options for mobility-accessible guests.

facts.text: Guests can contact the Concierge to plan their vacation activities.
facts.excerpt: Contact our Concierge to begin planning your vacation fun.

facts.text: Sanctuary offers private, interactive 90-minute mixology classes.
facts.excerpt: Sanctuary offers the ultimate Scottsdale mixology experience with private, interactive 90-minute mixology classes.

facts.text: Jade Bar serves a la carte hand-rolled sushi and nigiri prepared fresh to order by the resort's sushi chef.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy the best Scottsdale sushi with a la carte hand-rolled sushi and nigiri prepared fresh to order by Sanctuary's talented Sushi Chef.

facts.text: Jade Bar has a valley view.
facts.excerpt: Join us daily for a spectacular valley view

facts.text: Elements restaurant has sweeping views of the surrounding mountains.
facts.excerpt: festive dinner at Elements. With sweeping views of the surrounding mountain vistas

facts.text: Sunrise hot air balloon rides in the area drift over the Sonoran Desert, showcasing Camelback Mountain.
facts.excerpt: Rise and shine early to capture the beauty of dawn from the basket of a hot air balloon. A 60-minute ride drifts over the Sonoran Desert, showcasing Camelback Mountain

facts.text: Frank Lloyd Wright's Taliesin West, in the foothills of the McDowell Mountains, can be visited on a tour.
facts.excerpt: Visit Frank Lloyd Wright’s desert camp, Taliesin West, located in the foothills of the McDowell Mountains

facts.text: The Camelback Casitas showcase the best views Camelback Mountain has to offer.
facts.excerpt: Showcasing the best views Camelback Mountain has to offer
